ID11.unit: bytes per descriptor payload buffer and enqueue admission limit
ID11.producer: ID11 owner constructor computes a serialized-payload capacity bound from configured object/frame capacities, then passes that value into the generic queue constructor.

separate_parser_state_allocation.relation: Separate parser-state allocation, not queue payload limit.

ID11.consumer: Generic enqueue compares its U32 queue payload limit against descriptor U32 declared payload byte length. If declared length exceeds limit, returns5 before copy or queue flag publication. Otherwise copies exactly declared bytes into one destination descriptor payload buffer.

layout.descriptor_body: Pointer to source bytes; ownership preserved by copy into queue storage

ID6.consumer: General-group push locates ID6 queue, delegates to the same generic enqueue byte comparison, maps queue status5 to group status3 and occupied4 to2.
